name: PeakCart Group Corp
summary: PeakCart Group Corp., through its subsidiaries, distributes wine, spirits, food, beverages, health supplements, and related consumer products in the Asia Pacific, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company also provides market expansion services, including sales and marketing, distribution and logistics, regulatory services, after-sales services, sourcing, and market insights. In addition, it engages in international trade, e-commerce, brand development, international distribution support, and distribution and sourcing relationship activities. The company markets its products through social media, e-commerce platforms, and direct commercial relationships. It was formerly known as Hydro Power Technologies Inc. and changed its name to PeakCart Group Corp. in June 2026. The company is headquartered in West Covina, California. PeakCart Group Corp. operates as a subsidiary of Mountain Share Transfer, Inc.
